limits: The original exception identifies remaining estimated future-start lead at most 0.1 seconds; the exact original failure clock and stage costs were not recorded. It does not prove the absolute scheduled time had already passed at the exception.
The original saved admission checkpoint predates observed-start assignment. Missing observed-start details in that file do not mean its check was not reached.
Original CI145 chose a different relative curve than CI146. Its success is a separate observation, not a retry of the failed path or a performance comparison.
The original unchanged curve was re-evaluated offline with zero ROS goals. This is not an actual replay of the original dispatch or a reconstruction of its wall delay.

The 2.25-second injected preparation check is deterministic regression evidence. New actual stage durations and remaining margins are individual diagnostics, not a speedup, reliability rate, or original CI146 timing.

Planning 10 mm and observed-start 1 mm self-clearance thresholds are sampled experimental settings. They do not certify continuous-time clearance, physical hardware safety, exact FCL shape behavior, or unknown tracking errors.
Intentional collision comparison is a distinct negative control with its existing contact/cancel behavior. It is not counted as zero-contact safe execution.
Latest-head remote CI, protected merge, main followup and publication are recorded separately from these frozen local results.

The original CI147 freshness gate correctly rejected at a recorded state age 0.318593411 seconds while remaining start lead was 0.681511996 seconds. This is distinct from the CI146 reservation-order failure.
The original 147 mint-to-current-boundary interval does not identify the individual deepcopy, tuple/JSON, hash, filesystem, geometry or scheduling contributions.

Latest code requires genuinely newer joint and clock callbacks with advancing original simulation times. It retains 0.3-second receive-age and 0.1-second remaining-start limits, one original one-second reservation, and existing fixed-schedule expiry.
Latest actual stage costs, callback counts and remaining margins are diagnostics of identified runs only; no before/after timing or reliability statistic is claimed.

error.message: Joint state is stale at native self admission

interpretation: Preparation completed before a single original one-second reservation; this is not the CI146 pre-reservation ordering failure.
The 0.3-second state freshness gate rejected correctly while recorded remaining future lead was 0.681511996 seconds.
No avoidance goals were submitted; the two cumulative successful goals belong to setup.
The recorded 125.273ms interval includes confirmation work without per-operation measurements; the individual deepcopy, serialization, hash, filesystem and geometry shares are not determined.
The error does not establish a native transport loss or a collision failure.
Original failure and source 70 local actual successes remain separately preserved; no rerun, threshold relaxation or automatic retry.

implementation.full_native_policy_hash: Once during preparation, unchanged complete SHA identity checked against opened native metadata, with lstat/stat snapshots before and after full reads. Final quick stat checks retain inode/device/mode/size/mtime/ctime bindings.
implementation.relative_messages: Private copies and exact nested immutable tuples of arm/controller/frame/joint order, positions/velocities/accelerations/effort and integer sec/nanosec knots are prepared before the first reservation. No repeated large JSON encoding or deep message copy after mint.
implementation.exact_submission_equality: Every goal admission still checks the mutable outgoing messages against the original exact tuple; observer mutation cannot authorize a different spline. Finite numeric and duration/stamp type checks preserve former non-finite rejection.
implementation.genuine_observations: Bounded callback pumping requires newer validated joint and clock counts, increasing original simulation timestamps and original callback receipts strictly after the synchronization began. Freshness is never manufactured by changing a receipt.
implementation.pump_bound: At most2 seconds before mint. Once an original schedule exists, every pump iteration checks its remaining estimated lead greater than0.1 seconds, cancellation, native contact latch and backward clocks; no wait may extend the reservation.
implementation.final_checks: After real refresh, exact messages/source-policy-model identities/current native clearance/start anchor/cancel/freshness are checked again immediately before dispatch. Existing execution-ledger ownership applies if a first arm was sent before a later admission abort.
implementation.telemetry: At most64 cost rows and32 boundary rows per admission, explicit omitted counters, synchronization callback counts/time advancement, original receipt ages and remaining reservation margin. Full hash, copy/tuple work, genuine synchronization, exact seal, quick stat, current geometry and stamping have separate elapsed observations.
